name: Sora-chan
source: A stuffed penguin Corona bought and for some reason became alive. No one seems to care much about how and why it became alive. After becoming alive it moved out of the Akahoshi residence and bought a house in the neighborhood. An alcoholic who loves cars, motorcycles and such.
